title: LaB Media
description: A small film studio and a public notebook, run out of Shelby Township, Michigan.

items.title: Site updates : August 18
items.content_text: Past events stopped disappearing. Scattered leads the homepage.

items.title: Site updates : August 6
items.content_text: The notebook asks a question now. Four resource lists became one notebook. The tool tiles started running. Six tools, one page to find them on. The Tools menu learned to group itself, and What’s New stopped being a dead end. The colophon was quietly lying about three things.

items.title: Site updates : August 2
items.content_text: What's New became its own page. The weather tool commits to its name. One Tools menu, and the two SkyBounds finally sit together. Every film answers the same four questions. Scroll away from a film and it offers you a way back. It’s a Boy was a four-day shoot. A third shoot joins On Set, without shipping a single new file. Scattered had a poster this whole time. On Set makes room for a second film. The photographs get their photographer. Four more frames from The Hook, and the day they were taken. You can keep a whole film now, not just a frame from one. The day's light windows say their hours out loud. The photo viewer stops standing on its own pictures. The endorsement got out of the doorway. The menu learned the same lesson as the shelf. One name for the whole flight desk. A small correction to the Notebook's own story. The tool shelf, in better order. The Notebook tells the whole truth. The timeline tells time, and speaks up. The viewer learns some manners. The reel has two faces. The pile of prints grows bolder. Two more films keep their frames. It's a Boy is out in the world. Fair Questions, set like the Colophon. Softer edges on the About page. Photos that end where the page does. A face for the About page.

items.title: Site updates : August 1
items.content_text: Small corrections, site-wide. The night shift clocks in. Colophon reads like a description, not a diary. A footer that matches the menu. Golden Hour, softened. Golden hour, weather included. Weather after dark. Sun and moon, untangled. Local film knowledge, connected. Golden Hour, framed tighter. Flight planning, kept close. Detroit 48HFP screenings added. Golden Hour, rebuilt. Maintenance pass. Housekeeping. Themes renamed. Drone Weather, part two. Flight safety, expanded.

items.title: Site updates : July 31
items.content_text: The tool shelf fills out. Story Generator grows teeth. A fifth theme. The assistant settles in.

items.title: Site updates : July 27
items.content_text: Site design system unified to editorial direction. One stylesheet, one token set, one nav, one footer. Replaced 11 divergent style blocks.
